result.instructions: Tools for StatusPal, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StatusPal data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run statuspal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run statuspal_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run statuspal_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. statuspal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: statuspal_get_summary
tools.title: Get status page summary
tools.description: Get the FULL status-page summary — status_page, services[], incidents[], maintenances[], upcoming_maintenances[], info_notices[], and current_status_type. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/summary.

tools.name: statuspal_get_status
tools.title: Get overall status
tools.description: Get the current overall status of the status page (the aggregate status type). StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/status.

tools.name: statuspal_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services on a status page — each with {id, name, current_incident_type, children[]}. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/services.

tools.name: statuspal_get_service_status
tools.title: Get service status
tools.description: Get the current status of a single service by its id. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/services/{service_id}/status.

tools.name: statuspal_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents for a status page. Returns {incidents[], links:{next,prev}, meta:{total_count}}. Use `before`/`after` cursors to paginate and `type` to filter. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents.

before.description: Pagination cursor — return incidents before this cursor.

after.description: Pagination cursor — return incidents after this cursor.

tools.name: statuspal_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: statuspal_list_metrics
tools.title: List metrics
tools.description: List the metrics configured on a status page. Use `before`/`after` cursors to paginate. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/metrics.

before.description: Pagination cursor — return metrics before this cursor.

after.description: Pagination cursor — return metrics after this cursor.

tools.name: statuspal_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: PUBLISHES a new incident to the LIVE public status page (and, with notify=true, emails/notifies subscribers). type="major" or "minor" is an outage incident; type="scheduled" creates a scheduled maintenance window. StatusPal: POST /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents.

type.description: Incident type. "major"/"minor" = outage severity; "scheduled" = a maintenance window.

starts_at.description: ISO8601 start time (optional; required for scheduled maintenance).

updates.description: Optional initial updates to post with the incident.

description.description: The update message shown on the status page (required).

posted_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp for the update (optional; defaults to now).

notify.description: Whether to notify/email subscribers about this update.

tools.name: statuspal_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: UPDATES an existing incident on the LIVE public status page (title/type/services/timing). StatusPal: PUT /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

service_ids.description: New set of affected service ids.

notify.description: Whether to notify/email subscribers about the change.

tools.name: statuspal_create_incident_update
tools.title: Post incident update
tools.description: POSTS an update (e.g. investigating → identified → monitoring → resolved) to an existing incident on the LIVE public status page (and, with notify=true, notifies subscribers). StatusPal: POST /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}/updates.

incident_id.description: The incident id to post an update to.

description.description: The update message shown on the status page (required).

posted_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp for the update (optional; defaults to now).

notify.description: Whether to notify/email subscribers about this update.

tools.name: statuspal_delete_incident
tools.title: Delete incident
tools.description: DELETES an incident from the LIVE public status page — this permanently removes it. StatusPal: DELETE /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.
